name: rankrat
description: Connect OpenClaw to a running Rankrat server over Streamable HTTP MCP: account-authorized SEO audits, monitoring, Google Tag Manager, Microsoft Clarity, managed edge redirects, safe Bing content submission, internal links, Bing backlink intelligence, CrUX, ownership, remediation, analytics, Cloudflare performance, PageSpeed, and optional local Lighthouse tools. The plugin is a stdio-to-HTTP bridge to $RANKRAT_URL/mcp; run the server yourself.

RANKRAT_URL.description: Base URL of your running Rankrat server, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp).

RANKRAT_TOKEN.description: HTTP bearer from the server profile's secrets/rankrat/http-bearer-token. Required unless the server runs without a bearer.
